title.narrative: A CORE CONTRIBUTION TO SUPPORT PCHR’S 2023 WORK PLAN AND BUDGET FOR THEIR ACTIVITIES IN THE OCCUPIED PALESTINIAN TERRITORY (OPT).

description.narrative: The Palestinian Centre for Human Rights (PCHR), based in Gaza City, is dedicated to protecting human rights, promoting the rule of law and upholding democratic principles in Palestine. PCHR is guided by a five year strategic plan (2020-2024) and the three defined outcomes related to the strategic priorities are as follows:1. Working towards accountability for perpetrators of the most serious IHL and human rights abuses committed against Palestinians.2. Strengthening rule of law and increasing access to justice under Israeli and Palestinian jurisdictions for Palestinians, victims of human rights abuses with a special focus on women who are victims of gender-based crimes.3. Working towards greater respect for human rights, dignity, gender equality, and freedoms for Palestinians.
